name: Neko Dino
source:
A second-year high school student that works at his grandfather's cafe. He attends Grace Academy, a different school than everyone else.

He's a cool and handsome honor student. He likes jazz music and antique interiors. Although mature for his age, he holds no immunity to women despite it not showing on his face.

He's in the "Go Home Club." The feeling that makes him turn back into a beast is "anger."

[Translated from in-game profile]
